Event after _burn -> IERC1155Receiver callback path. Confirm burn state effects precede any callback and nonReentrant coverage.

Event after IBalancerVault.addLiquidity/settle inside the Balancer unlock callback. Callback executes within vault lock; verify no reentrant path re-enters pool()/dispatch().
Event after ISkyPSM(psm).buyGem external call. Benign-events; confirm state effects before buyGem.
BatchPooled event after IUniboostPooler.pool external calls in loop. Combined with external-call-in-loop (STATIC-014); confirm nonReentrant on batch entrypoint.

nonReentrant is not the first modifier. Modifier ordering: guards running before nonReentrant execute outside the reentrancy lock. Also affects Uniboost.pool:215, NudgeRatchetDelayRelease:108, BalancerPoolerMintDebtHook:120, NudgeRatchetMintDebtHook:136, UniboostMintDebtHook:141. Review ordering vs whenNotPaused.
